Data Sources

Measured knockout data version 2026-10-25.

  • Mouse Genome Informatics (MGI): knockout phenotypes curated from the literature
  • International Mouse Phenotyping Consortium (IMPC): systematic knockout viability and phenotyping screen
  • Alliance of Genome Resources: orthologs between human, mouse, rat, zebrafish, fly, worm and yeast
  • HGNC (HUGO Gene Nomenclature Committee): approved human gene symbols and their older names
  • DepMap 24Q4 Public (Broad Institute): CRISPR knockout screens in 1,178 human cancer cell lines
  • gnomAD v4.1 constraint: how rarely loss-of-function variants are seen in people
  • GTEx v8: gene expression in 54 human tissues
  • Ensembl Compara (via BioMart): paralogs: genes of the same species descended from the same ancestor gene
  • Saccharomyces Genome Database (SGD): yeast deletion phenotypes (viable / inviable)
